Under the contract Y cannot clone the file and must read and write all 128 MiB through fd_read and fd_write. Each needs at least 16.78 ms at 8 GB/s, on one core, because wasip1 is single-threaded. L = max(33.56/4, 16.78) = 16.78 ms. ln(16.78/5.01) = 1.21, which is greater than b = 0.236."}
